description.en: Branch a session into another Agent preset from any completed turn. The Agent preset label in the session header becomes a menu, and a Branch mode pill is added beside the built-in branch button under each completed reply; either entry creates a new session composed in the chosen preset and copies the conversation's event-log prefix up to the chosen turn, leaving the source session unmodified. A session that has not run yet switches preset in place. It uses create-plus-migrate rather than fork because DSH locks the preset after the first turn and its built-in fork inherits the parent preset.
description.zh: 从任意已完成轮次把会话分支到另一个 Agent 模式。会话标题栏的 Agent 模式标签变成菜单，每轮完成回复下方、自带分支按钮旁新增「分支模式」胶囊；两个入口都以所选模式新建会话，并把对话到所选轮次为止的事件日志前缀复制过去，源会话不被改动。尚未运行过任何轮次的会话改为就地为该模式。它走「新建 + 迁移」而不是分叉：DSH 在首轮之后锁定模式，自带分叉又必然继承父会话的模式。
